blocks.text: Church, it was the last night before the cross. Jesus and his disciples were gathered for the Passover supper.

verses.text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;

verses.text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

segments.text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus knew exactly who he was. Everything had been put into his hands. And look what he did with those hands.

verses.text: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

verses.text: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Say it with me. Somebody say, he took a towel. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "He took a towel"] He took a towel. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "He took a towel"] The Lord of glory got down on the floor with a towel and a basin.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The roads were dusty and everybody walked in sandals. Washing feet was the lowest job in the house, the job for a servant. Nobody at that table had offered. So the Master got down and did it himself.

verses.text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him,

segments.speaker: peter
segments.text: Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

verses.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Peter could not stand the thought of his Lord kneeling in front of him like a servant.

verses.text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

segments.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: narrator

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: So Peter went all the way the other direction, the way Peter always did.

verses.text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

verses.text: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

verses.text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus knew Judas would betray him that very night. And he washed Judas's feet too. Sit with that a minute, Church.

verses.text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

verses.text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

verses.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

segments.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: He did not just tell them to serve. He showed them, on his knees, with water and a towel.

verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

verses.text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Knowing it and doing it are two different things. The blessing is in the doing.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The one who had every right to be served chose to serve. He knelt in front of the friend who would deny him and the friend who would sell him out, and he washed them all. Then he told us to do the same for one another. Not to be seen. Not because anybody earned it. Because that is what love looks like when it gets down on the floor.

first_reader.note: Written by Claude in the landing session, then Claude's pastor and cultural read.

pastor.note: Faithful to John 13:1-17; no position on foot washing as an ordinance.

cultural.note: 'He took a towel' at the turn; service as love, not servitude.
